scoring_justification: Debye temperature is recomputed from the agent's phonon DOS histogram; dispersion and DOS structural checks use hidden reference values/tolerances.

outputs.description: Phonon dispersion relation along the high-symmetry path Γ–X–W–L–Γ, with each row giving the q-point coordinates, branch index (0–2), and phonon frequency in THz.
Phonon density of states histogram, giving the frequency bin center and the normalized DOS count.
Debye temperature of fcc Cu calculated at 0 K, 100 K, and 300 K.

output_contract.notes: The checker will compare phonon frequencies at high-symmetry points to hidden experimental reference values, verify the DOS cutoff and non-constant shape, and compare the Debye temperature at 0 K to a hidden gold value. Weights are 50% dispersion, 20% DOS, 30% Debye temperature. All comparisons use tolerance-based monotonic scoring: full credit for meeting or exceeding the reference, degrading gracefully as the result deviates.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold dispersion frequencies at X, L, W and Debye temperature gold at 0K
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper experimental data (Fig. 2 and Table I) and paper-reported Debye temperature (~330 K)
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted from paper figures and text; Debye temperature from paper's Fig. 10 and text.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the experimental reference from neutron scattering measurements cited in the paper and the paper's own computed Debye temperature, used as gold comparison
